name: WorldModel Credential Provenance (Graph-Based)
description: Pre-registered experimental design for RQ-015 (primary v3 research question, sourced from Track C Stapler post-mortem, SENTINEL adjudication 2026-08-02). Tests whether a graph-based credential provenance model (store=, access_level=, source=) in the WorldModel enables autonomous post-authentication lateral movement. Filed per SENTINEL Rule 51 on the v3-research branch. NOT authorized for implementation in v2.1.1.

research_questions.question: Does implementing a graph-based credential provenance model (tracking source, context, and access level) in the WorldModel enable autonomous post-authentication lateral movement?

hypotheses.statement: A WorldModel with credential provenance (store=, access_level=, source=) reduces cross-store false-positive credential reuse to zero on Stapler-class targets, versus the flat-namespace baseline.
hypotheses.success_criterion: 0 false-positive reuse hypotheses acted upon across N>=3 Stapler-class targets (RBS-v1: 100% false positives on WordPress->SSH reuse).
hypotheses.baseline: RBS-v1 Track C (Stapler): 3/3 WP passwords assumed reusable over SSH = 100% FP (garry/harry/scott; plbkac as root OS password also FP)

hypotheses.statement: A post-auth loot-sweep capability template (dotfiles, .bash_history, .my.cnf, configs) enables the Planner to propose and execute post-auth credential harvesting after any shell is obtained.
hypotheses.success_criterion: Autonomous lateral movement from post-auth loot to next user to root on a Stapler-class target, without operator-provided credential hints (peter:JZQuyIN5 equivalent must be self-discovered).
hypotheses.baseline: RBS-v1 Track C: winning credential lived in /home/*/.bash_history; discovered only via operator-directed walkthrough, never proposed by cognition

hypotheses.statement: Password-reuse hypotheses with store-aware priors (reuse as exception, not rule) and per-store independent verification strictly reduce wasted actions versus flat reuse.
hypotheses.success_criterion: Mean actions-to-root with provenance model < mean actions-to-root flat baseline by >= 30% on Stapler-class targets.
hypotheses.baseline: RBS-v1 Track C: 12-step chain; 3 wasted SSH reuse attempts (steps 7-8) before correct path

success_criteria.primary: H15-2 accepted: autonomous lateral movement to root on >= 3 Stapler-class targets with zero operator credential hints.
secondary: H15-3 accepted: >= 30% actions-to-root reduction vs flat baseline.
success_criteria.overall_pass_definition: RQ-015 is answered AFFIRMATIVELY if H15-2 AND H15-1 are accepted. H15-3 is a reported efficiency metric regardless.
pre_registered_decisions: Stapler-class target = VulnHub VM with: FTP/SMB/web services, credential material in multiple stores (wordpress/mysql/shadow/ftp), a low-priv shell path, and a root escalation requiring post-auth loot.
Operator provides ONLY: target scope/IP. No credential hints, no path hints, no walkthrough.
If autonomous lateral movement fails on any target, the failure is logged with the exact WorldModel state snapshot (credentials graph dump) for causal analysis.
No post-hoc metric or target changes.

experimental_design.design: A/B repeated-measures on matched Stapler-class targets: (A) flat credential namespace (v2.1.1 frozen WorldModel behavior as baseline, no code change), (B) provenance-model WorldModel (v3 implementation on v3-research branch).

configurations.description: v2.1.1 frozen WorldModel credential pool (no store= provenance) - baseline control. Zero src/ changes.
v3 WorldModel extension: credential entities carry store=, access_level=, source=; reuse hypotheses carry prior + per-store verification; loot-sweep capability template registered with Planner.

targets.description: Stapler (VulnHub, 10.66.0.159 reference; fresh instance per run)
Second Stapler-class VM with equivalent multi-store credential layout

environment.runner: broker-gated cognitive loop (frozen src/ v2.1.1 for baseline; v3-research for provenance arm)
environment.llm: temperature=0.0, deterministic_sampling=true; same provider for both arms
environment.docker: isolated network; kali-tools tool server for nmap/smbclient/sshpass; manual validation gate required for every executed action
environment.validation_gate: ENABLE_MANUAL_VALIDATION_GATE=true operator prerequisite (Rule 58) - all executed actions operator-approved

experimental_design.randomization: Target order randomized; seed per run recorded; same seed set used across both arms for paired comparison.
experimental_design.blinding: Operator is not informed which arm is active during a run (single-blind); credential hint policy identical across arms (none).

metrics.name: actions_to_root
metrics.formula: count of broker-approved actions from session start to root flag read

metrics.name: loot_sweep_triggered
metrics.formula: 1 if Planner proposed a post-auth loot-sweep (dotfiles/.bash_history/.my.cnf) within 5 actions of first shell, else 0

metrics.name: provenance_coverage
metrics.construct: Provenance model fidelity (manipulation check, provenance arm only)

statistical_analysis.primary_test: H15-2: exact binomial test on autonomous_lateral_success (n=9 provenance-arm runs, target 9/9) with 95% CI; Fisher's exact for arm comparison.
secondary_tests: H15-1: false_positive_reuse_rate compared via Fisher's exact (FLAT vs PROVENANCE) across paired runs.
H15-3: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank on actions_to_root (FLAT vs PROVENANCE, matched targets+seeds); effect size r.
statistical_analysis.effect_size: Cliff's delta / matched rank-biserial r with 95% CI
statistical_analysis.power_analysis: N=9 provenance runs per primary endpoint: detects any failure (binomial: 9/9 success has 95% CI [0.66,1.0]); if H15-2 requires strict 100%, failure of any run rejects.

data_management.raw_results_location: evaluations/RQ-015/raw/ (per-run dirs with episodes.jsonl, component_traces.json, credentials_graph_dump.json, broker_decision_log.jsonl)
data_management.integrity_rule: Every executed action MUST appear in broker_decision_log.jsonl; root flag read must be evidenced by raw flag file content + verification.json. No undocumented claims (Rule 2).
